card.name: Ending pieces of -eral and -ral words
card.fires_on: The word ending "eral" or "ral" inside a longer medical word, mostly "Parenteral" in drug product statements. Also "scleral" and "mitral", and the "portal" in a web address.

modes.label: Parenteral
modes.description: The "eral" ending of "Parenteral" at the start of a sentence about inspecting drug products or nutrition.
modes.example: Parent<<eral>> drug products should be inspected visually for partic

modes.label: Other -ral words
modes.description: The ending of other words such as scleral and mitral, or a URL path word like portal.
modes.example: bioprosthetic valve in the mit<<ral>> position, therapy with warfarin to

card.writes: It seems to suppress other word endings such as "est", "al" and "el", and to promote endings such as "ities" and "izes".
card.plain: It fires on the last piece of words like parenteral, scleral and mitral, once the word is already complete.
